info.title: SYNTHORA Inference
info.description: Pay-per-prompt LLM inference for agents: POST a prompt, get the completion. No API keys, no accounts. Multi-provider cascade for reliability, Ed25519-signed. 0.002 USDC via x402 on Base. SYNTHORA.
x-use-cases: run a prompt and get a completion
generate text from a prompt without an API key
summarize or rewrite text via an LLM
give an autonomous agent pay-per-call inference
classify or extract from text with an LLM
